dates.desc: Regional music festival featuring local and regional artists celebrating the New West sound. Multiple stages, food vendors, craft beverages, and vibrant festival atmosphere. Great for music discovery and outdoor summer fun.

dates.where: Silver Lake — Deer Valley Resort, Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Live Music at Silver Lake — Deer Valley (Moonshroom)

dates.where: The Forum at Canyons Village — Park City, UT 84098

dates.name: Utah Lake Kayaking or Paddleboarding — Summer Water Adventure
dates.desc: August is perfect for Utah Lake dates! Crystal-clear waters, warm 75-degree summer days, and scenic views. Rent kayaks or paddleboards from Lindon Marina and spend the afternoon on the water. Beginner-friendly exploration date.
dates.where: Lindon Marina — Lindon, UT (25 min north), or Utah Lake State Park

dates.name: Bells Canyon Trail — Granite Canyon Waterfall Hike
dates.desc: Stunning hike just 25 min from downtown! Two choices: easy 15-min hike to Lower Reservoir or more challenging 2-mile trek to Lower Falls. Granite-walled canyon with breathtaking views. Best to go early morning in August to avoid heat and crowds.
dates.where: Bells Canyon Trailhead — Sandy, UT (25 min south)

dates.name: Park City Trail Network — Mountain Biking or Hiking Adventure
dates.desc: Park City has 400+ miles of scenic mountain trails! Perfect summer weather for exploring. Choose easy to challenging hikes or bike rides with stunning views. Bring water and go early to beat the heat.
dates.where: Park City Mountain Resort & Trail Network — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Wildlife & Sunset Scenic Loop
dates.desc: Drive or hike the 7-mile scenic loop spotting native bison herds, pronghorn, and bighorn sheep. August offers clear skies for stunning Great Salt Lake sunset views. Peaceful, scenic, perfect for your love of exploration dates.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075 (45 min north)

dates.name: Snowbird Alpine Tram — Mountain Peak Scenic Ride
dates.desc: Ride the 2,000-foot aerial tram to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) for breathtaking 360° views of the Wasatch Mountains and Salt Lake Valley. August brings clear weather and cool alpine air. Option to dine at the summit restaurant.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — Little Cottonwood Canyon, UT (45 min east)

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City Seasonal Chef's Menu
dates.desc: Intimate, chef-driven restaurant featuring celebrated seasonal small plates. Fresh fish, heritage meats, creative vegetables. Excellent wine list and outdoor patio perfect for summer dining. Romantic and sophisticated.
dates.where: Handle — 412 Main St, Park City, UT 84060 (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon Fine Dining
dates.desc: Scenic mountain setting four miles up Millcreek Canyon with refreshing alpine air. Sophisticated seasonal menu, beautiful mountain views, excellent service. Perfect romantic summer escape from the heat.
dates.where: Log Haven — 6451 Mill Canyon Rd, Salt Lake City, UT 84121 (15 min south)

dates.name: Dinner at The Tree Room — Sundance Mountain Fine Dining
dates.desc: Tucked into the mountains at Sundance with cool alpine breezes. Seasonal American cuisine, mountain views, rustic elegance, exceptional service. Romantic summer escape.
dates.where: The Tree Room — Sundance Resort, 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: Chuck Wagon Dinner — Sundance Horseback & Cowboy Meal

dates.name: Outdoor Movie Night — Ashton Gardens Thanksgiving Point
dates.desc: Bring a blanket, grab popcorn and dinner, enjoy a movie under the stars at beautiful Ashton Gardens in Lehi. Summer evening atmosphere, scenic garden backdrop. Fun and romantic outdoor experience.
